requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement, incorporating the time-based condition and the specific decision metric provided in the controlled context.

source_fragments: Shut off the pumps if the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds.

fields.condition: the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds
fields.measurable_criterion: The decision metric for the 4-second window is the absolute minimum reading.

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds (where the decision metric is the absolute minimum reading in the window), the system shall shut off the pumps.
structuring_notes: The condition is temporal, requiring a persistence check. The controlled context (BR-01) was used to refine the measurable criterion for the time window.
